feedback: deterministic, grounding, and model story critics accept

findings.detail: name questions must request the full name explicitly
opening paragraph must read as narration, not an ID table
Deterministic grounding reports all required visible facts assigned once and sentence-anchored.
The evidence is conveyed in coherent prose paragraphs rather than tables, bullet ledgers, or personnel-index walls.
Each named watchkeeper has one compatible status assignment for each of the six streams; no contradictory same-person/same-stream assignment is apparent.
The main, intermediate, counterfactual, and tally questions are unambiguous under the disclosed status scale, recurrence procedure, and qualification rule.
The main-answer name is not asserted in the narration. The accepted tally is explicitly supplied as an obligated premise and supports the scalar question.
